title: Bakery Morning ABC
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: warm 3D preschool bakery storybook, golden bread tones and pastel icing, clean counters, isolated baked goods

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: storybook bakery visitor using pretend motions only
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 notices shape, layers, crust, swirl, crumb or topping; keep it descriptive and musical rather than advertising sweetness.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses a clean recall gap and visual shape/layer/swirl gestures with empty hands; no real baking operations are instructed.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: warm guitar/marimba crumb-sized answer, never a commercial jingle sting.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: warm guitar/marimba crumb-sized answer, never a commercial jingle sting
